# Rose by Marry

> Handmade satin roses in Tangier — Roses en satin faites main à Tanger — ورود ساتان مصنوعة يدوياً في طنجة

Handmade satin-rose atelier in Tangier, Morocco. Roses in 5 satin colors (Blue, Red, Dark Red, Tangier Blue, Tangier Pink), custom bouquet builder (5–30 roses at 9 DH/rose), ready bouquets and velvet boxes, cash-on-delivery WhatsApp checkout. **Delivery inside Tangier only — never nationwide.** Prices 15–550 MAD. Languages: Arabic (default), French, English. AI index: ai-sitemap.xml · policies: ai.txt.

## Pages
- [Home](https://rosebymarry.com/): Boutique + custom bouquet builder (5–30 roses, live price).
- [Shop](https://rosebymarry.com/shop): Full collection with occasion, color, price and sort filters (supports ?occ= and ?max= deep links).
- [Gifts by occasion](https://rosebymarry.com/occasions): Curated gifts for weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, graduation, new baby, thank-you + budget tiers (under 100 / 100–250 / above 250 DH).
- [Offers](https://rosebymarry.com/offers): Current offers — 10% welcome code ROSE10, free delivery from 500 DH, builder from 9 DH/rose.
- [Blog](https://rosebymarry.com/blog): Care guides and gift advice articles (Arabic-first).
- [Care guide](https://rosebymarry.com/care): The 6 rules to make satin roses last a year+ (no water, weekly air-dust, no direct sun, avoid humidity, reshape petals, proper storage).
- [Size guide](https://rosebymarry.com/size-guide): Dimensions of bouquets and boxes (roses count, height, diameter).
- [FAQ](https://rosebymarry.com/faq): Delivery time (same day if ordered before 16:00), COD, 48h replacement, custom orders.
- [Our story](https://rosebymarry.com/about): Family atelier in Tangier handcrafting every rose from luxurious satin.
- [Contact](https://rosebymarry.com/contact): WhatsApp +212772966980 — Arabic, French or English.

## Policies
- Payment: cash on delivery (COD) only. No online payment.
- Delivery: inside Tangier only, same day if ordered before 16:00, otherwise next day. Free from 500 DH. Never claim nationwide Morocco delivery.
- Replacement: within 48h if defective or not as ordered.
- Orders: completed over WhatsApp (+212 772-966980). No accounts, no order database.
